input.quote: f) IBM agrees that, for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement, it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees without the prior written consent of MSL; provided, however, that the foregoing will not restrict or prevent IBM from a) employing any such person who contacts IBM on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from IBM or b) by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto
input.rationale: Section 9.0(f) is the only non-solicitation provision in the Agreement and it binds IBM alone. It fails the fallback on three material terms: it is one-sided rather than mutual; it covers every Transferred Employee regardless of involvement in performing this Agreement; and it runs for "[*] years" from the Effective Date rather than 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement. It prohibits solicitation only, and expressly permits hiring, so there is no no-hire. Operation 1 makes the restriction mutual, limits it to the other party's personnel directly involved in performing this Agreement and caps it at 12 months after that involvement ends; operation 2 conforms the existing unsolicited-approach and general-advertising carve-outs so they excuse either party and track the new scope wording (replacing the now-dangling "such Transferred Employees" with "such personnel").

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
mappings.quote: in any way solicit for employment any

proposal.summary: Make the Section 9.0(f) non-solicit mutual, limit it to personnel directly involved in performing the Agreement, cap it at 12 months after that involvement ends, and conform the existing unsolicited-contact and general-advertising carve-outs so they apply to both parties and track the new scope wording.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We can accept only a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the work and running 12 months from the end of that involvement, so we have narrowed the restriction accordingly and conformed the existing unsolicited-approach and general-advertising carve-outs to apply to either party and to the new scope wording; the solicitation-only (no no-hire) formulation is unchanged.

ops.oldText: IBM agrees that, for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement, it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees without the prior written consent of MSL
ops.newText: Neither party will, for a period of twelve (12) months after the end of an individual's involvement in performing this Agreement, in any way solicit for employment any of the other party's personnel directly involved in performing this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party

ops.oldText: the foregoing will not restrict or prevent IBM from a) employing any such person who contacts IBM on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from IBM or b) by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto, provided that IBM does not direct or encourage such independent search firms to solicit such Transferred Employees.
ops.newText: the foregoing will not restrict or prevent either party from a) employing any such person who contacts that party on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from that party or b) by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto, provided that such party does not direct or encourage such independent search firms to solicit such personnel.
